dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.help: Controls how dates are displayed in the web UI and TUI. Dates in markdown files are always stored as yyyy-mm-dd.

autoCommit.label: Auto Commit
autoCommit.help: Automatically commit changes to Git after task operations

remoteOperations.label: Remote Operations
remoteOperations.help: Fetch tasks information from remote branches

defaultEditor.label: Default Editor
defaultEditor.help: Editor command to use for editing tasks (overrides EDITOR environment variable)

definitionOfDone.title: Definition of Done Defaults
definitionOfDone.description: These checklist items are added to new tasks by default.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Manage the fixed label list and give each one a custom color.

assignees.title: Assignees
assignees.description: Manage a fixed roster of assignees offered as suggestions. Names outside this list can still be added freely per task.

autoOpenBrowser.label: Auto Open Browser
autoOpenBrowser.help: Automatically open browser when starting web UI

hideEmptyColumns.label: Hide Empty Columns
hideEmptyColumns.help: Hide board columns whose status has no tasks. Columns reappear while dragging a task so they remain valid drop targets.

maxColumnWidth.label: Max Column Width
maxColumnWidth.help: Maximum width for text columns in CLI output

taskResolutionStrategy.label: Task Resolution Strategy
taskResolutionStrategy.help: Strategy for resolving conflicts when tasks exist in multiple branches

zeroPaddedIds.label: Zero-Padded IDs
zeroPaddedIds.help: Number of digits for ID padding (0 = disabled, 3 = task-001, 4 = task-0001)

taskPrefix.label: Task Prefix
taskPrefix.help: Set during initialization. Cannot be changed to avoid breaking existing task IDs.
